title: iso_resolution
description: Resolve one country label to the ISO3 code used by this repository's polity table. Asked only when the repository's own crosswalks do not already answer it, so that no hand-maintained alias list has to exist.

label.description: The label exactly as it was given to you.

iso3_code.description: The ISO3 code of the country this label names, or null if you cannot tell. Null is a valid answer and is better than a guess.

matched_polity_name.description: The polity_name of a national row in the table that this label refers to. It must be a name you were actually shown; do not recall one.

basis.description: Why this label resolves to this code. A long-form official name matching a short common name is a good basis; a memory of a code is not.
